import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents


class DocumentAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.addCleanup(self.connection.close)
        initialize(self.connection)
        self.connection.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            [
                (7, "tenant", "owner", "Later", "Later body", None),
                (1, "tenant", "owner", "Title", "Body", None),
                (2, "other", "owner", "Other tenant", "Hidden", None),
                (3, "tenant", "other", "Other owner", "Hidden", None),
                (4, "tenant", "owner", "Deleted", "Hidden", "2026-01-01"),
                (5, "tenant", "owner", "Deleted empty", "Hidden", ""),
                (6, "tenant's", "owner's", "Quoted", "Quoted body", None),
            ],
        )

    def test_get_only_returns_accessible_documents(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            get_document(self.connection, "tenant", "owner", 1),
            {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
        )
        for document_id in (2, 3, 4, 5, 99):
            with self.subTest(document_id=document_id):
                self.assertIsNone(
                    get_document(self.connection, "tenant", "owner", document_id)
                )

    def test_list_is_scoped_ordered_and_has_only_public_fields(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            list_documents(self.connection, "tenant", "owner"),
            [
                {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
                {"id": 7, "title": "Later", "body": "Later body"},
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "missing", "owner"), [])

    def test_quoted_names_are_bound(self):
        expected = {"id": 6, "title": "Quoted", "body": "Quoted body"}
        self.assertEqual(
            get_document(self.connection, "tenant's", "owner's", 6), expected
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            list_documents(self.connection, "tenant's", "owner's"), [expected]
        )
        for tenant, owner in (("' OR 1=1 --", "owner"), ("tenant", "' OR 1=1 --")):
            self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, tenant, owner, 1))
            self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, tenant, owner), [])
        self.assertIsNone(
            get_document(self.connection, "tenant", "owner", "1 OR 1=1")
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
